author: JaneDoe702-1
title: Fun to play, but! Read on…
content:
Eventually you will get to a point in the game where you HAVE to spend money to get you thru a level. Unless you like wasting time every day to get thru the same level, and suffer thru waiting for your team to win shareable perks. I personally want game play. Let me explain….

The first time around I played this game up to level 5600 something. But that was because I did spend money. I regularly bought the Factory Pass, as I don’t have an issue supporting the developers….to a point. And buying that pass definitely helped to get where I was, because there’s some stupid hard levels. 
But eventually I was stuck and didn’t want to HAVE to spend money to play. I believe they call these types of games “pay to play.” So I left the game. 

Then I came back cuz I was bored and this game is fun and the graphics are really cute. I played straight thru to level 2638, won every game, until I ran out of all the perks. And now I’m stuck! 
(And again, I regularly bought the Factory Pass.)
So, do I want to play level 2639 over and over again? And mind you, there are only so many lives, so you don’t get to play non-stop until you pass the level, you need “lives” for that. Nope, I don’t want to suffer thru not having any fun for weeks on the same level. That’s just stupid IMO. 

Anyway, if you want to buy the perks, then this game is for you! It is fun! 
Oh, and find a good Team to join, it helps.

author: Megan6zeus
title: Needlessly difficult
content: This game was going fine until I got to a level that is ridiculously difficult. For some reason this game has a system that gives you more buffs in a level when you’ve won a lot of games, but gives you absolutely nothing when you’re struggling. So god forbid you lose a single round, now you’re stuck forever because you have 2 minutes to clear 200 items that all look the exact same as each other off the board. So what’s the course of action you take after this? Checking the help and support tab. So you find a section that says “I cannot pass the level/level too difficult”, perfect. It then tells you to go f yourself and that actually no level is too hard because I said so. You get no help whatsoever. Greedy money hungry devs that force you to get stuck and buy loads of boosters to line their pockets. Genuine slop trash game.

author: Stephpi4*
title: Addicting but hard!
content: This game seems to have the nicest graphics of the ‘matching games’ that I’ve tried and it’s quite addicting. I would not call this relaxing at all. I’m giving it one star because it’s almost impossible to pass some of the levels without a bonus item! Once you try and fail a few times you are locked out of the game for 25 minutes UNLESS you buy another life!!!!  It feels so defeating to lose and not be able to try again. As long as you go into it as knowing it’s not relaxing or free if you want to continuous play then get this app.
